description: Live perp market context for one contract — current funding rate, open interest, mark price, oracle price, mid price, 24h premium, and 24h notional + base volume — from Hyperliquid's public info API ({"type":"metaAndAssetCtxs"}, matched to the requested coin by universe index). This is the single call that answers "what is BTC perp funding right now" or "what is Hyperliquid's open interest in ETH" — the live numbers next to kalshi_* and polymarket_* for anyone pricing crypto-adjacent prediction markets. For a HISTORY of funding rates rather than the current one, use hyperliquid_funding_history.

coin.description: Perp symbol, e.g. "BTC", "ETH", "SOL". See hyperliquid_perp_meta for the full list.

name: hyperliquid_asset_context
title: Hyperliquid Asset Context
